##### Project general facts

MAG 777 by MAG Property Development is a contemporary residential tower set in Dubai Sports City, designed to combine modern architecture with everyday functionality. The building’s clean white façade and sleek lines create a refined urban presence, while expansive windows open up views of the surrounding golf course and skyline. Offering a collection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, each residence is thoughtfully planned with efficient layouts and elegant interiors, delivering a comfortable and well-balanced living environment.

The development is complemented by a curated range of lifestyle amenities focused on wellness and relaxation. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped fitness center, yoga and Pilates spaces, and a spa featuring a sauna, steam room, and cold plunge. An infinity pool and dedicated leisure areas provide the perfect setting for unwinding, while BBQ zones and shared spaces create opportunities for social interaction, shaping a vibrant and well-rounded community atmosphere.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, reflecting attention to detail and a clean, contemporary aesthetic throughout. Kitchens come fully equipped, ensuring practicality and ease for daily living. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the flexibility to personalize their space while benefiting from well-designed layouts and refined finishing standards.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City is a vibrant and dynamic community that embodies the spirit of sports, leisure, and active living. Nestled within the heart of Dubai, this meticulously planned district is designed to cater to the needs of athletes, sports enthusiasts, and those seeking a balanced and energetic lifestyle.

Dubai Sports City is home to world-class sporting facilities, including the Dubai International Stadium and the Els Club golf course, providing residents and visitors with opportunities to engage in various sports and recreational activities. Whether it's cricket, football, golf, or tennis, the community offers a range of facilities to nurture both professional and amateur athletes.

The community's central location ensures easy access to Dubai's major attractions, business districts, and educational institutions. In addition, Dubai Sports City hosts numerous entertainment venues, dining options, and shopping destinations, offering a well-rounded and dynamic lifestyle.
